samples.question: Follow the one connected route from the red start cap to the green end cap. It has 33 solid-colored sections, each using one of the two visible route colors. For each of the 32 adjacent section pairs, write # when their colors differ and . when they match. Read those 32 marks in route order as a 4-by-8 bitmap and compare it with A) LOOM = 10011001/01100110/01100110/10011001 or B) KNOT = 00011100/00011000/11111011/00111100. Which symbol appears? Answer A or B. Ignore the caps, quiet route window, distractors, and background.
